programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.

programme.desc: Carved beneath Dover's White Cliffs, tunnels dating to medieval times served as WWII command centres where Operation Dynamo was planned. The Fan Bay Deep Shelter housed 200 soldiers. Today, these historic passages are open to explore.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh

programme.title: Steve Ronin
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned property once sold to become a horse preserve, left undeveloped for years, with stories of its former owners adding mystery.
programme.sub-title: This Abandoned Mansion Still Had Jewelry Locked Inside

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: An episode exploring abandoned Fukushima shops left intact and a highly contaminated car graveyard, showing rarely seen, previously undocumented sites.
programme.sub-title: The Radiation Ghost Mall inside Japan's Abandoned City (Highly Contaminated)

programme.title: Steve Ronin
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned Japanese billionaire mansion filled with priceless art and luxury decor, left untouched after its mysterious owner vanished.
programme.sub-title: Abandoned Japanese Billionaire’s Family Mansion with $200M Left Behind

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Greeks Play Land, built in 1970 by The Greek for handicapped children using repurposed materials, was free to all but closed after his death due to lack of upkeep.

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: Founded in the 1960s in an abandoned gunpowder factory near Liskeard, Trago Mills grew into southwest England's quirky retail giant, blending discount shopping with leisure attractions like go-karts, an ice rink, and the UK's largest model railway.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Deep in the Swiss mountains near France, dozens of Volkswagen Beetles have been hidden in a cave for 20+ years. Stolen or abandoned? No one knows.
programme.sub-title: Hundreds Of Stolen Cars Found In Cave

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring Albania’s communist-era military relics, including an abandoned airbase with planes and a submarine bunker, while facing plenty of bad luck along the way.
programme.sub-title: Albanian military relics from the Communist regime

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Ikeshima is an abandoned island in Nagasaki, Japan, once home to coal miners. After the mines closed in 2001, residents left everything behind.
programme.sub-title: Japan's Most Haunted Abandoned Island: 10,000 People Disappeared Here

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: The team travels to Fukushima by bullet train to explore a vast, near-empty arcade before visiting a historic building that survived the 2011 tsunami, learning how it served as a refuge during the disaster.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Cranebank near Heathrow trained thousands of British Airways staff from the 1960s until 2021, now abandoned as a haunting aviation relic.
programme.sub-title: The Abandoned London Airport Terminal: 747 Planes Parked Forever (Shocking Discovery)

programme.title: Steve Ronin
programme.desc: Steve explores South of the Border, a strange roadside attraction that feels abandoned yet still alive - staying overnight to uncover its eerie truth after dark.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Formosa Fun Coast in Taiwan closed after a 2015 color powder fire killed 15 and injured 508. The park has been abandoned ever since.
programme.sub-title: The Accident That Shocked the World - Abandoned Water Park Disaster

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring a once secret underground train factory built inside a mountain during Cold War China, later declassified, abandoned in 2008 and frozen in time.
programme.sub-title: Exploring a secret military underground train workshop

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: We explore an abandoned hospital opened in the early 1800s, soon to be demolished after the city went bankrupt and shut it down.
programme.sub-title: Abandoned Biohazard Hospital - Humans Left behind

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: In Scotland, Dan venture through a vast, decaying Victorian psychiatric hospital. Untouched patient rooms and medical equipment lie abandoned. The team uncovers dark histories of overcrowding and mistreatment, while hunting for paranormal activity.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Explore a recently abandoned high school before demolition, with preserved classrooms, theater, gym, and student items left behind.
programme.sub-title: The Richest Abandoned High School In USA

programme.title: Steve Ronin
programme.desc: Exploring the abandoned Hachijojima Grand Hotel in Japan, once a luxury island resort, now reclaimed by nature as tourism faded away.
programme.sub-title: Abandoned Millionaires Royal Hotel with Cars and Everything Inside

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: Hidden in County Wicklow's woods, this eerie Irish sculpture park features massive black granite statues exploring birth, death, and the darker sides of the human mind. Designed for adult reflection, every figure tells a deeply thought-provoking story.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Josh set out to central France to document an abandoned castle that was once owned by a victim of the Titanic disaster.
programme.sub-title: Exploring The Real Abandoned Hogwarts Castle

programme.title: Halloween III: Season Of The Witch
programme.desc: En ond leksakstillverkare planerar att sälja miljontals masker som dödar alla barn som bär dem på Halloween.

programme.title: The Last Man on Earth
programme.desc: After watching the world around him become devastated by an apocalyptic plague which turns the living into a zombie-like creatures, Robert Morgan begins to lose hope until he encounters another survivor.

programme.title: Body Parts
programme.desc: När Bill Chrashank förlorar sin arm i en bilolycka, opereras armen från en avrättad dödsdömd brottsling fast i dess ställe. Det enda problemet, som Bill snart upptäcker, är att armen är besatt av en kraft han inte kan kontrollera.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksanställd upptäcker en mystisk växt med en blodtörstig aptit. Framgång följer, men priset visar sig vara människoliv, och situationen eskalerar.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In June 1984, 15-year-old cheerleader Kirsten Costas was lured out and stabbed five times by jealous classmate Bernadette Protti in Orinda, California. The case inspired the TV movie Death of a Cheerleader.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1967, 75-year-old widow Louisa Dunne was raped and strangled in her Bristol home. The case remained unsolved for 57 years until DNA evidence led to the 2025 conviction of 92-year-old Ryland Headley.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In January 1999, 28-year-old Meekiah Wadley was bound and smothered in her Richmond, CA home, leaving her infant daughter behind. The cold case was finally solved 22 years later through familial DNA technology.

programme.title: Gabulosis: A Summer Boy Scout Trip That Turned Into a Decades Long Mystery: What Happened to Garrett Bardsley?
programme.desc: On August 20, 2004 Garrett Bardsley told his father he was going to walk back to camp to change his clothes after falling in the water while they were fishing. He was never seen again and no clues have ever surfaced.
programme.sub-title: A Summer Boy Scout Trip That Turned Into a Decades Long Mystery: What Happened to Garrett Bardsley?

programme.title: Gabulosis: The Tragic Case of the Boy in the Bundle
programme.desc: On July 11, 1963 a fisher in the Keene Creek in Ashland, Oregon reeled in a small bundle. At the center of this bundle was the body of a small boy. A boy who would be unidentified for until 2021.
programme.sub-title: The Tragic Case of the Boy in the Bundle

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Eleanor Williams claimed she was trafficked and beaten by a grooming gang. Her Facebook post went viral and sparked protests across the UK. But the truth behind her allegations shocked everyone. A case that changed several lives forever.
programme.sub-title: Her EVIL Lies Ruined COUNTLESS Lives: The Horrific Crimes of Eleanor Williams

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In December 2019, 30-year-old Nadine Lott was brutally beaten by her ex-partner Daniel Murtagh in her Arklow, Ireland apartment. A neighbor witnessed him attacking her "like a wild animal," growling with rage. She died days later.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Sydney Loofe went on a Tinder date and never came home. The investigation uncovered a calculated murder planned by two predators. A solved true crime case that will stay with you.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Alice Ruggles was stalked and murdered by her obsessive ex-boyfriend after the system failed to protect her. Her family now fights to make sure it doesn't happen again. A solved true crime case everyone needs to hear.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Horrific Murder of Alice Ruggles

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In October 1983, 15-year-old Tony Muncy's dismembered remains were found in garbage bags along a rural Ohio road. The case went cold for decades until DNA genealogy identified killer Daniel Anderson in 2020.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: When Mengqi Ji vanished, her husband claimed she walked out on him. But cell phone data, muddy boots, and a juniper tree in a state park told a very different story. A solved true crime case about control, lies, and justice.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Tragic Case of Mengqi Ji

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In November 1993, 19-year-old college student Wanda Musk was abducted at knifepoint from her gas station job in Flint, Michigan, and beaten to death. DNA from a prisoner law finally solved the case in 2013.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In January 2018, 19-year-old gay college student Blaze Bernstein was lured to a California park by former classmate Samuel Woodward, who stabbed him 28 times. Woodward was convicted of hate crime murder in 2024.

programme.title: Gabulosis: The John Doe in the Grand Canyon Garage: The Haunting Mystery of The Kolb Skeleton
programme.desc: In 1977, a human skeleton dating back to 1933 was found hidden in the rafters of famed photographer Emery Kolb's garage at the Grand Canyon. Its identity remains unknown to this day.
programme.sub-title: The John Doe in the Grand Canyon Garage: The Haunting Mystery of The Kolb Skeleton

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A doctor is gunned down on the Ohio Turnpike in what looks like a random robbery. His grieving wife told a convincing story until investigators proved she ordered the hit. A solved true crime case that is brutal, calculated, and deeply personal.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Case of Dr. Gulam Moonda // MURDER FOR HIRE PLOT

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A Coast Guard mother's baby is found dead in her crib in Alaska. What looked like SIDS turned into a criminal case built on a coerced confession, so the conviction fell apart in court. A true crime case full of unanswered questions.
programme.sub-title: US Coast Guard Confessed to Smothering her Baby, but the Case Fell Apart

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: She sent voice notes to friends saying she feared the worst. Weeks later, a gunman broke into her home looking for her boyfriend and opened fire. A solved true crime case that is devastating, gang-fuelled, and a stark warning about deadly loyalty.
programme.sub-title: She PREDICTED Her Own Murder: The TERRIFYING Killing of Ashley Dale that Lead to MULTIPLE Arrests

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A pastor's pregnant wife is shot during a home invasion while he's at the gym. Police cleared him fast, but the public wasn't convinced. A solved true crime case full of suspicion, conspiracy theories, and heartbreak.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED? The Tragic Murder of Amanda Blackburn // WAS IT REALLY HER HUSBAND?!

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: Illinois serial killer Bruce Lindahl accidentally severed his own femoral artery while stabbing a victim in 1981, dying on the spot. Decades later, DNA forensics posthumously linked him to over 12 murders.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1994, 6-year-old Rikki Neave was strangled by 13-year-old James Watson in Peterborough, England. His mother was wrongly accused. DNA evidence eventually solved the case in 2022, nearly 30 years later.
programme.sub-title: The Boy Who Almost Got Away

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A man meets a woman on Facebook who says she needs help. Hours later, his throat is slashed and he's thrown off a bridge into a river. Against all odds, he survived. A solved true crime case that is savage, predatory, and an incredible story of survival.
programme.sub-title: She used Facebook to Lure him in... Then she Slit his Throat & Threw him off a Bridge

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A woman stalks and kills her estranged husband's new girlfriend in broad daylight while witnesses watch. She tried to cover it up, but the evidence was overwhelming. A solved true crime case that is vicious, obsessive, and heartbreakingly avoidable.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: Jealous Wife Kills Her Husband's New GF: The Tragic Case of Michelle Boat & Tracy Mondabough

programme.desc: En lojal partner är A och O på Paradise Hotel men, en back up är minst lika viktigt. Ytterligare en kille tvingas lämna hotellet och den efterföljande festen får svartsjuka att blossa upp.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Cirkusen har anlänt till Paradiset men, faror lurar i manegen. En galen mördarclown är lös på hotellet och när som helst kan någon bli mördad och tvingas checka ut.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Festen får svartsjukan att frodas och teorierna om vem som är hotellets mördarclown går isär. Två spådamer checkar in för att hjälpa till att lösa mysteriet men, vad är egentligen den röda tråden?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Pandoras Ask kommer aldrig lägligt men kanske extra olägligt just ikväll. En allians ”behind the scenes” blir allt starkare, men kommer spådamerna att lyssna på den alliansen eller inte?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det är aldrig kul när en annan tjej vill ha ens kille och speciellt inte på Paradise Hotel. Hemliga allianser riskerar att avslöjas när parceremonin tvingar alla att visa sina rätta färger.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det mytomspunna hotellet på Mexikos dramatiska västkust slår återigen upp portarna och det är ett taggat gäng som checkar in. Men, allt kan hända på Paradise Hotel och särskilt i händerna på JLC.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: JLC fortsätter styra premiärveckan med järnhand och redan andra dagen kommer tiden på hotellet vara över för några av gästerna. Starka känslor har etablerats mellan flera av deltagarna.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Känslorna fortsätter svalla på hotellet och spelet är i full gång. En tjej tvingas checka ut och planer smids inför den kommande parceremonin.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Säsongens första parceremoni går till historien och efterspelet är inte nådigt. Allianser börja sakta men säkert luckras upp och hur pakterna kommer se ut framöver är högst oklart.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Ny vecka i Paradiset och frågan är om hotellet är en himmel eller ett helvete? Hemligheter avslöjas och två nya gäster checkar in för att röra om ordentligt i grytan.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En av de nya gästerna visar sig ha ett förflutet med en av killarna, till hans partners stora förtret. Ett svek uppdagas som vänder upp och ner på hela hotellet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Skärselden fortsätter att locka fler offer och ett oväntat erbjudande dyker upp. Hur långt är man beredd att gå för att ta sig vidare? Dessutom har det blivit dags för säsongens första Pandoras Ask.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det uppdagas att flera på hotellet har blivit erbjudna samma sak, utan varandras vetskap, och stämningen blir minst sagt kylig. Parceremonin närmar sig, men innan dess ska en av tjejerna checka ut.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Parceremonin tvingar ytterligare en tjej att checka ut och frågan är, kan lojalitet leda till attraktion? Åtminstone verkar det fungera så på Paradise Hotel.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Skolveckan är i full gång och det vankas prov i ordkunskap. Kärlek blomstrar mellan ett par av eleverna och Frökens Favorit checkar in.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En av eleverna tvingas checka ut när Frökens Favorit tar hans partner, och fler elever börjar känna kärleken spira. Skolans Värsting gör entré och det är ingen duvunge som kommer.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Vem målade Mona-Lisa? Och är Kuwait ett land eller en frukt? Nya prövningar väntar eleverna när en immunitet står på spel. Dessutom rör en dagsfest upp starka känslor – precis innan parceremonin.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: Andromeda: Vægten (del 2)
programme.desc: Beka bliver dumpet på Seefra, efter at Andromeda er blevet stjålet, og Dylan skal bevise, at skibet er hans.

programme.title: Andromeda: Phear Phactor Phenom
programme.desc: På Seefra finder Dylan dog Harper, som har tilpasset sig til livet der.

programme.title: Andromeda: Englens forfald
programme.desc: Det viser sig, at Doyle er en android, som Harper har bygget til at indeholde Rommies kerneprogrammering.

programme.title: Andromeda: Eskatologien i vores nutid
programme.desc: Beka vinder en pris fra en radio-DJ, lærer sandheden om Seefra og finder Meethus-diagrammet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Når det går rundt...
programme.desc: En videnskabsmand fra det oprindelige Commonwealth dukker op og er fanget i en tidsløjfe.

programme.title: Andromeda: Forsøg på afretningslag
programme.desc: Flavin vender tilbage, hvilket udløser en bandekrig, og hjælper Dylan med at udvikle sig som Paradine.

programme.title: Andromeda: Så brænder de utæmmede lande
programme.desc: En krystal, der kan genoprette Andromedas kraft, bliver fundet, men for at få fat i den må Dylan arbejde for minens ejer.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hvad der vil ske, var ikke
programme.desc: Der er opdaget tunneller på Seefra, som kan bruges til at nå otte andre Seefra-planeter.
programme.sub-title: Hvad der vil ske, var ikke

programme.title: Andromeda: Prøven
programme.desc: Da en gammel mand bliver dræbt, er Beka, Rhade og Harper de hovedmistænkte og skal for retten.

programme.title: Andromeda: Gennem et mørkt glas
programme.desc: Rhade leder oprørerne i en kamp mod en krigsherre på Seefra-5.

programme.title: Andromeda: Stolthed før faldet
programme.desc: Dylan finder ud af, at Bekas kæreste var Drago Musevini, og at han brugte Bekas DNA til at skabe nietzscheanerne.

programme.title: Andromeda: Måneskin bliver til dig
programme.desc: Beka og Rhade finder en prøve, der enten vil give dem stor rigdom eller drive dem til vanvid.

programme.title: Andromeda: Fortiden er uendelig
programme.desc: Harper opdager et program, der kan ødelægge otte af Seefra-planeterne og dræbe millioner af mennesker.

programme.title: Andromeda: Modsætningerne af tiltrækning
programme.desc: Mens Harper arbejder på en måde at redde Seefra-systemet på, sniger en spion sig om bord på Andromeda og angriber Beka.

programme.title: Andromeda: Saving Light From a Black Sun
programme.desc: Der gøres et forsøg på at reparere Seefras blinkende sol, men Trance erstattes af en dobbeltgænger.
programme.sub-title: Saving Light From a Black Sun

programme.title: Andromeda: Samlet tilbagekaldelse
programme.desc: Da Dylan bliver alvorligt såret i en laboratorieeksplosion, rejser han gennem en række alternative virkeligheder.

programme.title: Andromeda: Quantum Tractate Delirium
programme.desc: Rommie bliver genopbygget for at hjælpe med at evakuere Seefra-systemet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Endnu en dags lys
programme.desc: En krigsherre overbeviser sine tilhængere om, at den forestående ødelæggelse af de ydre planeter er et komplot, der skal gøre det lettere for dem at plyndre deres planet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Kaos og stilheden i det
programme.desc: Dylan, Rhade og Beka arbejder sammen for at redde Trance fra Methus-2 og Harper fra general Burma.

programme.title: Andromeda: Rejsens hjerte (del 1)
programme.desc: Besætningen når endelig ud af Seefra-systemet og opdager, at Dylan er den sidste Paradine

programme.title: Andromeda: Rejsens hjerte (del 2)

programme.title: Forensic Files: Critical Maneuver
programme.desc: When a hit-and-run accident claimed the life of a high school athlete, everyone in town mourned his passing. Finding the killer was a long shot at best.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Gambler
programme.desc: One warm summer afternoon, the town of Verona, Wisconsin faced its first triple homicide. To solve the case, investigators had to delve into the world of high rollers and offshore betting.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In the Bag
programme.desc: After shooting his victims in the head, the killer staged the scene, placed the incriminating evidence into a plastic bag and tossed it into the river.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Kidnapping
programme.desc: In 2001, Ginger Hayes and her infant son were abducted during a carjacking. The crime had been reported by a witness within minutes of occurrence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Naughty or Nyce
programme.desc: A woman appears to have lost control of her SUV and plunged down an embankment into a shallow creek. But investigators suspect foul play when they find snowy footprints leading away from the crime scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sworded Scheme
programme.desc: When a college student is reported missing, police believe their investigation will be like countless others. But when they discover blood spatter in her boyfriend's bedroom, they know this case is going to be different.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Road Rage
programme.desc: Police investigate a discarded sleeping bag containing bloody sneakers and a purse, which eventually leads to the body of a young woman. A mark found on the victim's body enables police to track the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Woman Scorned
programme.desc: When Joann Katrinak is found dead in a corn field with her infant son, the obvious suspect is the husband and father of the victims. But insects found on the bodies reveal a vital clue which uncovers a twisted story of passion gone wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Four on the Floor
programme.desc: When a Native American woman is brutally killed in the desert of New Mexico, her killers leave a crime scene rich in forensic evidence: tire tracks, shoe impressions and even the murder weapons.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Broken Bond
programme.desc: Doctors are puzzled when a two-year-old boy is rushed to the hospital with brain seizures and breathing difficulties. Finally, the boy's sister provides an important clue, raising the possibility of a rare syndrome.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Disappearance of Helle Crafts
programme.desc: In the series premiere of "Forensic Files", the longest-running true crime series in history, a Connecticut flight attendant goes missing. Police suspect her husband is guilty of murder, but can they prove it?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Body of Evidence
programme.desc: Mark Fair left for work and his fiancée, Karla Brown, stayed home. Later, he found her dead. During the autopsy, bite marks on her body were re-examined and forensic odontology identified the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writing on the Wall
programme.desc: The victim was well-liked and successful, which made the brutality of the crime even harder to understand.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skirting the Evidence
programme.desc: A murder trail turned cold, until police got a call from a woman whose husband, Gerald Powers, had a criminal past and a fondness for Chevy Berettas.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Weakest Link
programme.desc: The body of a young girl was discovered on isolated farmland near Delano, California. She had no ID, but police found mailbox keys in the pocket of her jeans. With no other clues, they checked the mailboxes of every apartment building in Delano.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: A young woman suddenly becomes critically ill, eventually leaving her unable to walk. A bone marrow test reveals the cause: arsenic poisoning. Investigators must determine if the poisoning was caused by groundwater contamination or something sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Quite a Spectacle
programme.desc: It was one of the most unusual cases in forensic history. Investigators had to find a way to solve a murder case using only a squashed tomato found at the crime scene and tiny, pinpoint reflections of light in a photograph.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Brotherly Love
programme.desc: In 1969, 25-year-old phone operator Diane Maxwell was raped and murdered. Her brother promised he'd find out who was responsible and bring the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Death by a Salesman
programme.desc: No one in a quiet residential community saw anything unusual the day one of their neighbors was brutally attacked and murdered. Fingerprints found at the crime scene and surveillance video helped investigators to apprehend the presumed killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Order Up
programme.desc: A man is found dead in his home and his ex-wife has a perfect alibi. To determine time of death, investigators need to know when the victim ate his last meal. An endocrinologist, a forensic botanist and a short-order cook answer their question.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Safe Place
programme.desc: A wealthy man and his wife were attacked by three masked men outside their luxurious Louisiana home. He was shot dead and she was forced to open their hidden safe. To solve the crime, police would have to find out who knew about the concealed safe.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Charred Remains
programme.desc: Shortly after daybreak, a fire is started in a dumpster in Vancouver. No one sees the arsonist or the fire, which burns for hours in the deserted parking lot. But there's more than garbage in this flaming container.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Horse Play

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient sky watchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: From There to Here
programme.desc: The sky above is studded with stars and countless galaxies. In them, we can read not only our origin, but also our final destination. Technology is on the brink of taking us to places we have only dreamed of.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: There are many more worlds in our solar system than just the planets. The mysterious moons of the gas giants may hold much more than we ever imagined. Each one is unique, and each one deserves a scrutinous eye.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.
programme.sub-title: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Rocky Shores / Silent Partner
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: Mars has fired our imagination for thousands of years. The tantilizing possibility of life has made it the most inviting planet in our solar system. It is the only other place that man may one day call home.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface
programme.desc: The interface between Earth and space is the Ionosphere, a region of rarified gas and charged particles. It is very important for radio communications, radar, satellite signals and global positioning. Yet we know so little about it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 1: The Solar System
programme.desc: This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 7: The Milky Way
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Sun
programme.desc: The sun bathes our planet in warmth and light. It powers the machinery of nature, our weather, and it encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. We study it closely, and it can reveal the secrets of all other stars.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit
programme.desc: Chances are, you are watching this program by satellite, one way or the other. Every day we use these wonders of human design, from communication and weather observation, to GPS and recourse management.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Sling Shot
programme.desc: Soviet Luna 3 was the first to use gravity to change course to photograph the dark side of the Moon. NASA Mariner 10 used the technique to swing by Venus to target Mercury. The gravity sling shot maneuver has become a standard for space navigation.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 3: Asteroids
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 6: Fermi paradox
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: How to Colonize the Stars: The Challenge of Interstellar Flight
programme.desc: Leading physicists and engineers in the field of interstellar travel discuss some of the deep issues we face when considering the problem of sending spacecraft to other stars. Will mankind ever truly become a space fairing civilization?

programme.desc: Brody og Kaitlynn har stadig problemer i forholdet, da de besøger en fertilitetslæge. Heidi og Spencer forbereder sig på at forny deres løfter med konkurrerende polterabends. Brandon har svært ved at definere sit nye forhold.

programme.desc: Audrina fortæller Heidi om Spencers utroskab, men Heidi tvivler - indtil hun ser det selv. Lauren tvivler stadig på, om hun er parat til et forhold.

programme.desc: Heidi holder en pause fra Spencer, men savner ham mere end hun havde håbet på. Lauren skal planlægge en middag for Teen Vogue, men ryger i baggrunden til fordel for superpraktikanten Emily fra New York.

programme.title: The Hills: Goodbye for Now
programme.desc: I sæsonfinalen tilspidses tingene, da Heidi beslutter at flytte ind med Spencer. Lauren vil have Audrina til at fylde tomrummet efter hendes bedste veninde, og Whitney flyver til New York til et interview.

programme.title: The Hills: You Know What You Did
programme.desc: Lauren går ikke til Heidi and Spencers housewarming fordi Heidi har spredt rygter om hende. Så da Lauren løber ind i Heidi har de et kæmpe skænderi.

programme.title: The Hills: Big Girls Don't Cry
programme.desc: Lauren og Heidi bliver endnu mere uvenner da Spencer frier til Heidi. Audrina finder sammen med en ekskæreste og Lauren vender hjem til Laguna Beach for at få et godt råd.

programme.title: The Hills: Truth And Time Tells All
programme.desc: Lauren prøver at hjælpe Audrina med at beslutte om Justin har kærestekvalitet, men Audrina har allerede truffet sin beslutning. Heidi finder ud af, at det ikke er lutter lagkage at være forlovet.

programme.title: The Hills: Meet The Parents
programme.desc: Ifølge mig: et komisk twist på din yndlings reality-serie. Fra Lauren til Spencer og alle de andre, intet bitchy look eller bromance udelades af skuespilleren, der spilleralle de medvirkende.

programme.title: The Hills: Rolling With The Enemy
programme.desc: Heidis sociale omgangskreds krymper da Spencer 'slår op' med Brody fordi han har hængt ud med Lauren. Audrina vil være fast kæreste med Justin, men det nægter han at gå med til.

programme.title: The Hills: Second Chances
programme.desc: Lauren bliver ringet op af en ekskæreste. Heidi konkurrerer med sin kollega Elodie om at blive forfremmet på arbejdet.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Middagsdates med eks som tilbehør.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Taget på sengen

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Aftenstranden
programme.desc: Kan Lockie og Yaz finde ud af at bo sammen? Chloe lægger alle sine æg i en kurv og en djævelsk flot kendis ryster villaen, men hvem ryger hjem nu?

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Den eneste vej er eks

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Kayleigh's Crisis
programme.desc: 'Ex on the Beach' er tilbage! Otte hotte singler får snart ødelagt alle tiders ferie, da en af deres ekser ankommer og ødelægger festen! Had, skænderier, tårer, drama, følelser og endnu flere ekser!

programme.desc: Ankomsten af to ekser skaber kaos i villaen for alle, og det bliver kun værre. Rogans forhold til Anita går i stykker, når hans eks Jess ankommer på Dommedagsstranden. Mere kærlighed, mere had og vigtigst af alt flere ekser.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: I'm Sorry, I'm a Prick

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Star Gazing
programme.desc: Joes ankomst chokerer alle og Anita bliver helt ødelagt. Kayleigh skaber sig og fortæller Joe, at Anita har fjollet rundt med to af fyrene. Den næste eks er et velkendt ansigt som kan ødelægge det for Gaz og Anita. Velkommen Charlotte!

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Girl Code
programme.desc: Op af havet kommer et kendt ansigt - Ash fra den første sæson af Ex on the Beach - og han vil skabe KAOS. Alle pigerne er vilde med ham, fyrene frygter op og når Ash henter Anita til en privat fest, bryder helvede løs og Gary går amok!

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Anita's Almighty Meltdown
programme.desc: Det er næsten forbi, og nogle af ekserne slutter fred, men andre vil aldrig blive enige. Gruppen holder festmiddag og Anita får et sammenbrud, der overgår alle andre. Men hvem får et chok under den sidste tur til stranden?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US
programme.desc: 10 stjerner fra reality-tv og sociale medier tror, at de er på en sexet tropeferie, men paradiset forvandles til et mareridt, når deres ekser dukker op på stranden. Vil det tænde gamle flammer eller åbne gamle sår?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Being Shady 101
programme.desc: Den 10. single ankommer til villaen og lander midt i en kærlighedstrekant. Farrah provokerer sine bofæller. En eks spreder et ondt rygte, når sårede følelser giver sig udtryk i hævn.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Simon Says
programme.desc: Farrah får en stor overraskelse i Hemmelighedshulen. En eks af en eks dukker op og laver ravage i et spirende forhold og afslører nogle løgne. Den første eks bliver sendt hjem.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Worst Date Ever
programme.desc: To ekser går ssammen for at vælte Maya og hendes slæng. En uventet overraskelse bringer et af husets stærkeste par i fare.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Come One, Come All Part 1
programme.desc: For første gang nogensinde har kærligheden ingen grænser, når 16 singler ankommer til Hawaii for at finde kærligheden og vinde 1 million dollars.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Come One, Come All Part 2
programme.desc: Der er problemer i paradis for de stærkeste par. Et par kæmper med konceptet åbent forhold. Kærlighedstrekanter bliver rekonfigureret.

programme.title: Are You The One?: This is Trash
programme.desc: Justin er fanget mellem en, der vil have ham og en der ikke ved, hvad de vil have. Basit kæmper for at blive accepteret. Huset skal forholde sig til nogle svære sandheder.

programme.title: Are You The One?: We Come to Slay
programme.desc: Efter queer-prom er huset et figurativt og bogstaveligt rod. Det er forbi for to par. Dionne Slay ankommer.

programme.title: Are You The One?: There Was A Fivesome?
programme.desc: En femkant får dynamikken i huset til at smuldre. Justins selvdestruktive tendenser truer hans forhold til Max. Danny skaber kontakt.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Hate to Burst Your Bubble
programme.desc: Huset vil finde ud af, hvilke af parrene er et perfekt match. Jonathan vil knalde en kærlighedsboble. Kai stiller sig foran Jenna.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Red Flag Alert
programme.desc: Jonathan forsøger at gøre det godt igen med Basit. Et par kommer tættere på hinanden mens andre forsøger at ændre på deres giftige datingadfærd.

programme.title: Are You The One?: This Sucks and Blows
programme.desc: Venner og familie sætter fut i huset. Jenna forsøger at navigere strategi i forhold til hjerte. En tur i bolleværelset har eksplosive konsekvenser.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Games Players Play
programme.desc: De andre i huset må samle stykkerne op da Kais opførsel lægger alt i ruiner. Remy forsøger at lægge sin player-fortid bag sig for at overbevise Paige.

programme.title: Are You The One?: It All Comes Down to Jax
programme.desc: Tre par finder ud af, at de er et perfekt match og to par får en dårlig nyhed. Justin og Max får svar. Paige har svært ved at sænke paraderne.
programme.sub-title: It All Comes Down to Jax

programme.title: Are You The One?: On to the Next
programme.desc: De sidste tre par skal vælges, og en person ved, hvem deres match er. De nye perfekte match lærer hinanden bedre at kende.

programme.title: Are You The One?: All or Nothing
programme.desc: De har kun en chance tilbage for at vinde, og ikke flere kort på hånden, så alle må stole på, at de seks følger deres hjerte og vælger deres perfekte match. Amber er fanget mellem tre mulige partnere.

programme.title: Are You The One?: How Far Would You Go For Love? Part 1
programme.desc: Kærligheden slår straks gbister, da 22 singler fra hele verden flytter ind i et hus på De Kanariske Øer for at se, om de kan finde deres perfekte match og vinde 1 million dollars.
programme.sub-title: How Far Would You Go For Love? Part 1

programme.title: Are You The One?: How Far Would You Go For Love? Part 2
programme.desc: En nat går et par fra hinanden og går videre til nye forhold, mens andre par tror, de har fundet 'den ene'. Der er tryk på, da romantiske forbindelser bliver sat på prøve ved den første Match Up-ceremoni.
programme.sub-title: How Far Would You Go For Love? Part 2

programme.title: Are You The One?: Rollecoaster Relationships
programme.desc: Efter en hjerteskærende match up-ceremoni, kæmper nogle singler med at udforske nye forhold, men andre træffer egoistiske beslutninger, der påvirker resten af huset. Ærlige samtaler om ønsker og behov sårer nogens følelser.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Love Is Hell, Finding It Is Hell
programme.desc: En fest sætter gang i nye romantiske forbindelser, og en kærlighedstrekant dannes, da en single mistolker deres engangsknald.
programme.sub-title: Love Is Hell, Finding It Is Hell

programme.title: Are You The One?: Wants And Needs
programme.desc: En afsløring i Sandhedsbåsen ryster huset og efterlader et par i en akavet kærlighedstrekant. Et andet par må afslutte deres forhold, da presset fra huset begynder at tynge dem.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Da singlerne slår sig løs til en fest, truer jalousi med at afholde et par fra at tage på deres feriedate. Der opstår frustration da huset indser, at kun et af deres stærkeste par kan være et perfekt match.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Surprise-gæster giver singlerne råd og indsigt i, hvad der skal til for at finde deres perfekte match. En afsløring i Sandhedsbåsen ændrer dynamikken i huset.
programme.sub-title: It Takes One To Know One

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: I et hidtil uset øjeblik afslører Kamie et perfekt match ved match up-ceremonien. Et yndlingspar lærer endelig deres skæbne at kende. Et andet par fortryder deres brud.
